verdict.rationale: Gecko documents automatic PR-triggered scans, auto-generated fix PRs, automatic re-verification of fixes, automatic ticket creation, and an API to 'manage scan schedules' — all consistent with background automation running without manual intervention. However, there is no explicit doc on configuring recurring/cron-style scan schedules in the UI, and community reports raise concerns about scan reliability (missed/false findings, a stuck scan list), which undercuts confidence in unattended automation quality even if the triggering mechanism exists. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduling/cron configuration docs, independent confirmation that scheduled/background scans run reliably end-to-end.
